text: Hello everyone, welcome back, today we are going to enter our last lesson for this unit, further exploration and self-assessment.Today's lesson will serve to summarize this unit.By the end of this period, you are expected toWrite a reflective note in problem-solution mode and improve self-learning ability.Now, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.Let's dive into today's lesson.I wonder whether you have noticed this phenomenon.The restaurants in the airports always charge more than the ones in the downtowns.Even if the restaurants are fast food chains selling exactly the same food, why is that?What is the relationship between supply and price?You will have one minute to think.All right, what is your hypothesis?Amy, would you please?I believe it is because we don't have enough choices in the airport.There are only a few restaurants there, so I have to accept the higher prices.It means the lower the supply, the higher the price.Yes, I agree.It seems that when the supply decreases, the price increases.However, this is just our guess.Is it true or false?We need to explore more.So, to test your hypothesis, would you like to play a trading game?After the game, I hope you can understand trade and price deeper.Are you interested?I bet so.Now, let's go.First, I'd like to divide you into groups of five, and each of you will be assigned a special role in the group.You may be the information collector, whose duty is to collect useful information from the market.Or the accountant, who is to calculate and make budget plan for your group.Or the dealer, the delegate negotiating and make deals with his or her counterparts from other groups.Or the economist, who uses economic principles learned in this unit to analyze situations.Or the decision maker, who evaluates the economist's proposals and make the final decision.Now, you have one minute to assign your roles.Ready?Good.Now, read the instructions carefully on page 32, step 1.Each group has 10 cards with a total of 20 points, which serve as banknotes.There are five items on the market, and their prices are listed as follows.Gold, 5 points per unit.Smartphone, 4 points per unit.Oil, 3 points per unit.Clothing, 2 points per unit.And food, 1 point per unit.Now, let's conduct the first round of trading in five minutes.The first round of trading in five minutes.The second round of trading in five minutes.The third round of trading in five minutes.The fourth round of trading in five minutes.Let's share with you the discussion from group A.The way two of the other four groups love gold very much.They are likely to buy at least three units of gold while another group believes food is the most important product.So they will spend all their money on food, that is 20 units.The last group, very much like us, prefers to put the axe into different baskets.Okay, so our strategy now is to buy every item for one unit and leave five points of cash in hand.According to the current statistics, food is adequately supplied in the market.Gold seems to be more than needed, and oil, smartphone, and clothing are relatively less demanded.Considering the principle of the marginal change, I suggest that we buy another unit of smartphone,because it's valuable, worth four points, and leave one point in hand.Sorry, but I'm afraid that I have to remind you of one more thing.Opportunity cost theory tells us that the same amount of money values differently.When spent on different opportunities, we don't leave any cash.Instead, we spend the last point on oil.However, we don't have enough points to do that, so we sell our gold.Sure, I will make the deals in the market on our behalf.The world economy is barely predictable.Black swans can show up anytime.Here is the big news.HeadlineThe world is running out of oil, making oil extremely rare and much more expensive.The outcome is that the price of oil increases by two points.Here comes the second round of trading.You will have two more minutes to make your deals.The world is running out of oil, making oil extremely rare and much more expensive.The outcome is that the price of oil decreases by two points.You will have two more minutes to make your deal.在第二回合中, Group A的動作在第二回合中發生了什麼樣的動作?好消息,因為嚴格,油價升幅增長,我們將會達到根據我的計算,在第一回合中發行,我們有1盤油和1盤金我們把我們的金額加上1點,並買了2盤油現在我們沒有金額,只有3盤油,價值15點如果我們賣掉所有油,我們可以賺6點在發行中我認為這是一般的供應和需求分析當油的供應減少,油價的升幅增長因此,我們應該再購買油,然後再賣掉油,以賺更多點抱歉,我有疑問油比第一回合中的油價還要高你願意賺更多嗎?我恐怕不油價升幅增長,膝蓋的數量會下跌簡單來說,如果油價增長,你會喝更多水而不是跟著油,對嗎?我建議我們賣掉所有油,以賺更多點,然後購買其他產品這很合理兩回合後,我相信你應該有很多事情要考慮現在,我們來回顧你所學到的東西在遊戲中回答這幾個問題當你開始時,你的團隊賺得比開始時還要高嗎?是否容易和難以賺錢?哪個產品最受歡迎?哪個最受歡迎?再見OK,Kate,你願意分享你的想法嗎?遊戲結束後,我們團隊賺得更多但我們賺得比較難賺錢因為我們需要考慮很多因素可能會影響到結果我們認為食物是最受歡迎的產品而且賺得最受歡迎謝謝你分享現在是時候結束了你剛才所知道貿易是一個非常複雜的過程當每個團隊做出自己的決定時會有不少經濟理念某些團隊的經濟學家也有提出可能會影響到賺錢的結果因為我們覺得食物是一個必須的有一個團隊的經濟學家也有提出可能會影響到賺錢的結果而其他團隊的經濟學家也有提出可能會影響到賺錢的結果但是還有一些貿易家他們也有提出可能會影響到賺錢的結果所以他們的基本道德都是兩類貨幣價值現在是你們要做一個自行測試的時間請在頁面33的預期的學習結果中讀出這部份的學習結果並按下你認為你做得好並專注於你認為困難的學習結果並寫出一個反射的記錄使用問題解決模式你將有三分鐘完成記錄你現在要做的部分請在頁面33的預期的學習結果中讀出一個反射的記錄使用問題解決模式你將有三分鐘完成記錄使用問題解決模式使用問題解決模式使用問題解決模式OK, understanding the anchoring theory.I read the story again and again, but I was still at a loss.Fortunately, my English teacher gave me a lot of help and guidance.The group discussion helped me figure
